overview.description: The Defiance Daily Target 2x Long STX ETF (STXL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund seeks to deliver 2x leveraged exposure to the daily share price movement of Seagate Technology Holdings plc (NASDAQ: STX), less fees and expenses, through derivatives like swap agreements. STXL was launched on Apr 22, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
